sources: Google Maps place 'Clark Creek North Campground' (34.10305,-84.68254, 4.4 stars, 202 reviews), read 2026-10-29

hookups.source: Bartow County WebTrac site details, CCN 001-024 ('Standard Electric Site: Accommodates 30 & 50 Amp', 'Water Hookups', 'Dump Station on Site, No Sewer hookups'); https://www.bartowcountyga.gov/departments/clark_creek_north2.php ('All sites have water and electrical hookups'), read 2026-10-29

values.note: 24 RV sites, all on the water. Lengths 20-40 ft; 23 take a 23-ft rig (site 8 is 20 ft). Sites 8, 9, 10, 16 and 19 are pull-through in the booking system (8, 9, 10 and 19 are drive-through loops on the county map). Sites 9 and 10 allow no slide-outs.

sites.source: https://www.bartowcountyga.gov/9939_BCPR_ClarkCreekNorthCampground_2025updates_06-19-25.jpg (site numbers and lengths, 'NO SLIDE-OUTS' at 9 and 10); Bartow County WebTrac CCN 001-024 ('Equipment length/Driveway: 20' Pull-Through' etc.); https://www.bartowcountyga.gov/departments/clark_creek_north2.php ('24 campsites', 'All sites are water front'), read 2026-10-29

facilities.source: https://www.bartowcountyga.gov/9939_BCPR_ClarkCreekNorthCampground_2025updates_06-19-25.jpg ('REST ROOM AND SHOWER', 'DUMP STATION'); WebTrac 'Dump Station on Site'. No county page or the map shows laundry (the stored laundry came from the Corps-era note), so it is cleared. Read 2026-10-29.

values.note: Bartow County's WebTrac reservation site or the campground office, 770-607-6245. Golden Age / Access pass holders call the office to add the pass before booking. 14 nights in any 30 days at county campgrounds, then away 16 days. No check-in after 9:30 pm; gate closed 10 pm - 8 am.

booking.source: https://www.bartowcountyga.gov/departments/clark_creek_north2.php ('Click Here to make a Campground Reservation' -> WebTrac; pass-holder line with 770-607-6245); https://www.bartowcountyga.gov/departments/parksandrecreation/parks_and_facilities.php ('We now require a 2 night minimum stay at all campgrounds on Friday and Saturday nights'); Campground Rules rev. 2024-06-19 (items 2, 3, 8, 10), read 2026-10-29

values.note: $34 a night at every site, weekday or Saturday (November 2026, June 2027). No resident/non-resident rate shown. $10 fee on any cancellation.

fees.source: Bartow County WebTrac rental search, CCN 001-024 all '$34.00' for 06/15/2027; CCN 001-004 '$34.00' for 06/19/2027 and 11/10/2026; Campground Rules rev. 2024-06-19 ('ALL CANCELLATIONS WILL INCUR A $10.00 CANCELLATION FEE'), read 2026-10-29

note: Bartow County Parks & Recreation campground on USACE Allatoona Lake (formerly Corps-run by a contractor), on a peninsula off Glade Rd / Allatoona Gateway, Acworth; every site is on the water. Dock and swim beach. --Claude
summary: County page + 2025 county map + WebTrac: 24 waterfront sites, 30/50 A + water, no sewer, dump + shower house; lengths 20-40 ft (23 take 23 ft); 5 pull-throughs (stored pull_through false was wrong); $34 every night; 2-night weekend minimum, 14 nights in 30; open year round. Laundry (Corps-era) cleared. Pin matches Google's place pin (entrance/guardhouse). Lakefront supported (county: 'All sites are water front'). Note trimmed of counts/hookups/lengths/facilities/season/booking.
flags: Site 9 length disagrees: the county page lists '#9 35' camper - No slide outs', but the county map (2025 update) and WebTrac both say 25 ft. 25 ft is used.

Google Maps lists phone 770-387-5149 and https://secure.rec1.com/GA/bartow-county/catalog; the county page and map give 770-607-6245 (kept). The Rec1 catalog is not the campground engine (WebTrac is).
